neighbours.label: Positing an unseen or unknown agent behind what is observed (some unknown force, an unseen hand, a mysterious force field); its output promotes 'unseen, invisible, unknown, hidden'
fire: Astronomers think an invisible substance holds these galaxies together.
Many villagers blamed some unseen influence for the failed harvests.
Physicists suspect an unknown particle is bending the signal.
She felt that a mysterious energy was shaping the course of her life.
Economists describe an invisible hand that steers the buying and selling.
Something unidentified must be tugging on the outer planets.
The theory posits an undetected field filling all of space.
People once credited a hidden force with the movement of the tides.
quiet: Astronomers think a large telescope will photograph these galaxies soon.
Many villagers blamed the late frost for the failed harvests.
Physicists suspect a loose cable is bending the signal.
She felt that a long holiday was improving the state of her health.
Economists describe a small shop that sells to the buyers and sellers.
Something heavy must be sitting on the back seat.
The theory explains how ice floats on top of water.
People once used a heavy cart for the moving of the stones.

notes: Peak is often on the adjective or the determiner before it. A hidden power in a ouija frame read only 0.10.
